notes: Ordered queue for tools/model_improve.py. status=open means runnable when its `needs` are available; blocked means a human or an external dependency must act first.
criteria are frozen by the driver before execution; the evaluator never chooses them after seeing a result.
A negative verdict closes the hypothesis for this queue; re-opening it needs new data, a new feature class, or a fixed measurement bug and counts as a new trial in the same family.

hypotheses.title: Shuffled-label canary
hypotheses.mechanism: The full pipeline run on shuffled labels must be negative; if it produces skill, the measurement is leaking and the harness is void.
hypotheses.notes: Canary: a provisional outcome voids the harness and blocks further runs until harness-clear.

hypotheses.title: Positive (leaky-feature) canary
hypotheses.mechanism: A feature computed from the realised next-bar return must be detected as leakage; if a leaky feature can pass as skill, the harness is void.
hypotheses.notes: Positive canary: the lab injects a feature equal to the realised fwd_return. It must come out invalid (leak detector / controls), and a provisional outcome voids the harness exactly as the null canary does.

hypotheses.title: Baseline diagnosis
hypotheses.mechanism: Establish the current out-of-sample baseline on the committed archive before any change, so later claims have a control.

hypotheses.title: Pooled panel model
hypotheses.mechanism: One model trained on all tickers with per-ticker normalisation and ticker-time purged folds should reduce variance against the ~1,700-bar per-ticker sample limit.
hypotheses.evidence: Prior pooled-panel trial h1-panel-v1 on branch model-improve/2026-10-24-h1 (commit d598641) is negative: panel-vs-aligned-control paired 95% CI [-0.0046,+0.0092] includes 0, and the 24-bar shifted-label control beat baseline in 14/15 tickers, which voids the pre-registered run. The panel also added no material gain over the per-ticker model on fwd_volume_ratio.
hypotheses.notes: Blocked until the shifted-label null is fixed or a new H1 lineage is opened with a stated difference. Merge/account for d598641 first; do not silently re-test the same panel idea (trial_index would be wrong).

hypotheses.title: Longer history
hypotheses.mechanism: Backfill more bars per ticker and re-run the best current config to separate the data effect from the model effect.
hypotheses.evidence: Upstream pagination limits must be verified before planning; the archive currently holds ~1,700 hourly bars per ticker.

hypotheses.title: Cross-asset features
hypotheses.mechanism: BTC/ETH lead-lag returns, relative strength, and cross-sectional momentum ranks may carry information the per-ticker features cannot express.
hypotheses.evidence: The existing archive already contains all 15 tickers, so no new upstream fetch is needed; this is a feature-version bump.
hypotheses.status_reason: Pilot and design-scaled MDEs are both far above the economics-derived minimal meaningful effect at the 1h horizon and 15 bps/side round-trip cost.
hypotheses.reevaluate_when: Re-run `plan` after a longer horizon, a lower-cost execution assumption, or more history brings the design-scaled MDE at or below the MME.

hypotheses.title: Cost-aware policy
hypotheses.mechanism: Hysteresis, a minimum holding period, and an expected-move-above-round-trip-cost filter can turn a weak gross signal into a lower-turnover policy.
hypotheses.evidence: Every directional result so far is negative after 10+5 bps, and the current policy trades on every threshold crossing.
hypotheses.notes: Declares --policy hysteresis; the evaluator must charge costs on every position change.
hypotheses.status_reason: Pilot and design-scaled MDEs are both far above the economics-derived minimal meaningful effect at the 1h horizon and 15 bps/side round-trip cost.
hypotheses.reevaluate_when: Re-run `plan` after a longer horizon, a lower-cost execution assumption, or more history brings the design-scaled MDE at or below the MME.

hypotheses.title: Regime conditioning
hypotheses.mechanism: Trade direction only when predicted volatility/volume conditions are favourable, and size by inverse predicted volatility.
hypotheses.evidence: fwd_volume_ratio is the one target with a consistent holdout win; direction needs a conditioning variable.
hypotheses.notes: Declares --regime-conditioned; direction is gated by the skilful activity targets.
hypotheses.status_reason: Pilot and design-scaled MDEs are both far above the economics-derived minimal meaningful effect at the 1h horizon and 15 bps/side round-trip cost.
hypotheses.reevaluate_when: Re-run `plan` after a longer horizon, a lower-cost execution assumption, or more history brings the design-scaled MDE at or below the MME.

hypotheses.title: Cross-sectional relative direction
hypotheses.mechanism: Rank tickers by predicted direction and go long the top / short the bottom, which removes the market factor from the signal.
hypotheses.evidence: A long-only directional model is fighting the market factor; a relative rank is a different estimand.
hypotheses.notes: Declares --cross-sectional; ranking replaces the absolute-direction estimand.
hypotheses.status_reason: Pilot and design-scaled MDEs are both far above the economics-derived minimal meaningful effect at the 1h horizon and 15 bps/side round-trip cost.
hypotheses.reevaluate_when: Re-run `plan` after a longer horizon, a lower-cost execution assumption, or more history brings the design-scaled MDE at or below the MME.

hypotheses.title: Lower-frequency horizons
hypotheses.mechanism: At 4h and daily horizons the signal-to-cost ratio can improve enough for a directional edge to survive fees.
hypotheses.evidence: Hourly direction is noise-dominated after costs; the archive must carry interval metadata for honest non-overlapping evaluation.
hypotheses.status_reason: Pilot and design-scaled MDEs are both far above the economics-derived minimal meaningful effect at the 1h horizon and 15 bps/side round-trip cost.
hypotheses.reevaluate_when: Re-run `plan` after a longer horizon, a lower-cost execution assumption, or more history brings the design-scaled MDE at or below the MME.

hypotheses.title: New data classes
hypotheses.mechanism: Funding rates, open interest, and order-book imbalance may carry directional information that price-only features cannot.
hypotheses.evidence: Requires an upstream capability check and an archive schema change; needs explicit human approval.
hypotheses.status_reason: Pilot and design-scaled MDEs are both far above the economics-derived minimal meaningful effect at the 1h horizon and 15 bps/side round-trip cost.
hypotheses.reevaluate_when: Re-run `plan` after a longer horizon, a lower-cost execution assumption, or more history brings the design-scaled MDE at or below the MME.

hypotheses.title: Stronger model classes
hypotheses.mechanism: Boosted trees or small ensembles can capture non-linear interactions the linear reference model cannot, but only after the sample-size lever is tested.
hypotheses.evidence: Only worth trying after H1 or H2; needs the cumulative trial counter to stay honest.
hypotheses.notes: Declares --model-class boosted; only after H1 or H2, with the family trial counter.
hypotheses.status_reason: Pilot and design-scaled MDEs are both far above the economics-derived minimal meaningful effect at the 1h horizon and 15 bps/side round-trip cost.
hypotheses.reevaluate_when: Re-run `plan` after a longer horizon, a lower-cost execution assumption, or more history brings the design-scaled MDE at or below the MME.

hypotheses.title: Improve the skilful targets directly
hypotheses.mechanism: fwd_volume_ratio already beats its baseline on every ticker; better features and a model class for it produce a verifiable gain even though it is not directly tradable.
hypotheses.evidence: Volume-ratio holdouts pass 15/15 while direction passes 0/15.
hypotheses.minimal_meaningful_effect_justification: A 1% RMSE improvement in activity is a modest, non-tradable monitoring gain; it is not an economics-derived target.
